about: The ad rules register (Tzvi, 12 Nov 2026: rules as a building blueprint, the same as the page rules). One record per ad rule in docs/ad-rules-checklist.md, in checklist order: how it is made right while building (KIT shared ad code in AdMaker, AdStudio or a shared ad-kit module, GEN a script that makes it from the blueprint answers, ASK one blueprint question answered before making, OWNER a fact only the business owner can give, EYE the final look), what builds it today or the part still to build, and what confirms it. status built = the code or script already makes it right while the ad is made; planned = still to build, so today a check or a look catches it after (retried true marks build, check, retry rules). A new ad rule is added here with its building part the same day (check-rule-homes).

rules.rule: One job: a gain, a question or a real offer, never two
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief.json field 'job' (gain, question or offer), refused if empty or two

rules.rule: One-second test: a stranger knows what is offered and where
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'A stranger reads:' line (same field as A2.10), filled before any picture

rules.rule: Starts from a named ad that already works
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'source_ad' must be a file in docs/inspo/pinterest-ads-2026-11-02, checked on write

rules.rule: One sentence: what the picture says, the words finish
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'picture_says' and 'words_finish' fields, both required

rules.rule: The idea named by kind, not a photo with a headline
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'kind' picked from the ad-vs-library.py kind list, weak kinds refused up front

rules.rule: The angle named (moment, reader, trade-off, want, day, review)
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'angle' picked from a fixed list

rules.rule: Looks different from the business's last ads
rules.built_by: to build: ad-history.mjs lists the business's past ads (design, colour, layout) beside the new brief; AdMaker START_LOOK and FAMILIES already rotate looks

rules.rule: Gallery of one business looks varied; each starts on its own product
rules.built_by: AdMaker START_LOOK, FAMILIES and THEMED give each layout its own look

rules.rule: Headline is the biggest words and what the eye lands on
rules.built_by: to build: shared headline() in ad-kit that sets size from the words and is always the largest text on the canvas; AdStudio headline() and AdMaker draw functions each do it separately

rules.rule: At most about 8 words, never cut with an ellipsis
rules.built_by: to build: ad-copy-lint in the AdMaker words panel and the headline generator; AdMaker only warns on long headlines (headlineWords)

rules.rule: Who or where plus what, most concrete fact first
rules.built_by: to build: headline generator that takes who, where, what and fact from the listing record in ad-brief

rules.rule: In the reader's own words, from a real review when there is one
rules.built_by: to build: headline generator seeded from the listing's real reviews (ad.reviews is already loaded in AdMaker)

rules.rule: What it gets them, not the name again
rules.built_by: to build: five-headline generator (A2.11) requires a 'gets them' line per headline

rules.rule: Words a ten-year-old follows
rules.built_by: to build: ad-copy-lint with a reading-level check and banned power-word list

rules.rule: No long dash, no exclamation in the headline, no unstated praise
rules.built_by: to build: ad-copy-lint run on every words field in AdMaker and AdStudio and in gen scripts; no such check in the drawing code today

rules.rule: Hebrew in the plural, never to one man or woman
rules.built_by: to build: ad-copy-lint Hebrew rule (flags singular second-person forms) and a plural-first Hebrew prompt

rules.rule: Caption: who or where, one or two facts, one invitation, no hashtags or signature
rules.built_by: to build: caption builder from ad-brief; AdMaker withCaption joins headline and points but does not lint hashtags

rules.rule: Short, intriguing, clear: a stranger gets what is sold in one look
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'A stranger reads:' required before the headline is accepted; the headline generator output includes it

rules.rule: Five headlines, numbered, each failure struck, then cut
rules.built_by: to build: headline-five.mjs writes 5 numbered headlines, a strike table with fixed failure letters a to f and 'Chosen: N', stored in ad-brief

rules.rule: One huge subject on one quiet ground, two or three colours
rules.built_by: to build: ad-layout-sketch presets with the subject box at half width or more on one ground; AdMaker drawShoot, drawGiant and drawBehind already place one big product

rules.rule: Rental or place: only the owner's real photos
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'picture sources' list; AdMaker should refuse any generated image for property targets

rules.rule: Generated product picture keeps the real product, rebuilt around its real photo
rules.built_by: to build: docs/ads/gen/lib prompt builder that always passes the real photo as image 1 and writes the full reference scene (la-cholent-status/gen.py does it by hand)

rules.rule: Other shape than the screen: extend the background, never crop
rules.built_by: scripts/ad-fit-picture.py extends the plain wall and table in the picture's own colours and refuses to shrink; in-app photoInBox with sideColour and edgeColour

rules.rule: Sharp, bright, one colour that stands out on a white and a dark feed
rules.built_by: AdMaker vividColour and measureVivid pick the accent from the photo; sharpness from sharpCanvas

rules.rule: A hand holding, offering or reaching in where it helps
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'hand: yes or no and why', and the prompt builder adds it to the layout sketch

rules.rule: No words drawn into a generated picture; words typed on top
rules.built_by: AdMaker draws every word as its own canvas layer over the picture; to build: prompt builder appends a fixed 'no text in the picture' line

rules.rule: Borrow another brand's idea only, never its marks or product
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'borrowed from' states the idea only; the prompt builder never passes a reference ad image

rules.rule: Picture fills the ad edge to edge, laid with ad-fit-picture
rules.built_by: scripts/ad-fit-picture.py (full width, refuses to shrink); in-app photoInBox and fitIn

rules.rule: Product shot styled like a pro shoot, with named props
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'props' list (name and why) that the prompt builder turns into side props and a rich surface

rules.rule: Layout drawn first and given to the reference-image model
rules.built_by: scripts/ad-layout-sketch.py and the ad-gate hook, which refuses a gen script until stages 1 to 4 are answered

rules.rule: A screen in an ad is the real site or dashboard from the test account
rules.built_by: to build: ad-screen-capture.mjs captures a named page at the screen's shape from the local test account (?as=owner, sample data)

rules.rule: At most three points, each one fact
rules.built_by: to build: points field capped at 3 in the AdMaker words panel and in ad-copy-lint

rules.rule: One price, the price of the thing in the picture
rules.built_by: AdMaker adIssues(words, item) flags any price in the words that is not the featured item's, shown live in the panel as the owner types

rules.rule: Struck-through price only when real
rules.built_by: to build: ad-facts.json (real separate prices, past prices) from the listing; the deal text built only from it, never typed free

rules.rule: Review is real, public, 4 or 5 stars, the reviewer's words
rules.built_by: to build: review picker listing only the listing's public reviews rated 4 or 5, cut by trimming only; AdMaker drawReview takes ad.reviews from the server

rules.rule: Press or partner logos only if real, four at most
rules.built_by: to build: ad-facts.json 'press' list from the owner; the component refuses a fifth

rules.rule: The business's own real logo on every ad, clear of the phone's top bar
rules.built_by: AdMaker extras() places the listing's logo on every design (part 'logo', white tile for see-through logos); AdStudio uses a fixed site LOGO, to build: the same extras() in AdStudio

rules.rule: One action: short link and QR last on the eye's path
rules.built_by: AdMaker drawFooter, footBand, qrTile and linkPiece draw link and QR in every design

rules.rule: Nothing invented: number, feature, review, person, view, distance
rules.built_by: to build: ad-facts.json from the listing and owner; copy lint refuses a number or claim word with no source field

rules.rule: No scarcity or urgency unless real, with dates
rules.built_by: to build: ad-copy-lint banned urgency words unless ad-facts has a dated offer

rules.rule: No fake screenshot of a conversation that did not happen
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'who speaks' must be the product, a search box, switches or the reader's list; chat and post designs refuse invented speakers

rules.rule: No drawn @brand, no as-seen-in, no generated person as customer
rules.built_by: to build: prompt builder negative list and ad-copy-lint for '@' and 'as seen'

rules.rule: Comparison with a kind of thing, never a named rival
rules.built_by: to build: ad-copy-lint checks words against a rival-name list per category; versus design takes two kinds from ad-brief

rules.rule: No 'owners' wording; rentals lead; 'Add your business, free'
rules.built_by: AdMaker site-ad cta uses the 'Add your business, free' string; to build: ad-copy-lint bans the word 'owners' in ad copy

rules.rule: Square, feed and story each drawn, not resized
rules.built_by: AdMaker FORMATS and per-format draw; AdStudio SHAPES post and status

rules.rule: No text under 30px at 1080 wide
rules.built_by: to build: one shared text() in ad-kit with a hard 30px floor (today only the phone fonts and linkPiece clamp to 30)

rules.rule: Nothing cut off: every line inside the picture
rules.built_by: AdMaker wrap(ctx, text, width, maxLines) and part() with minScale shrink text into its box; to build: AdStudio to use the same

rules.rule: Story keeps top 220px and bottom 230px clear
rules.built_by: AdMaker begin() top 220 and footBand safe 230; AdStudio topOf and footTopOf

rules.rule: Words over a photo cover at most 40%, never the subject
rules.built_by: to build: ad-layout-sketch text boxes capped at 40% of the picture and clear of the subject box; AdMaker has no cap

rules.rule: QR at least 150px, dark on white, short link whole beside it, no drag can break it
rules.built_by: AdMaker QR floor of 150, qrTile white tile, linkPiece and linkLines print the whole link, part() minScale 150/QR on drag

rules.rule: Hebrew and English: right-aligned, QR to the left, fonts with the letters
rules.built_by: AdMaker rtl flag (qx = rtl ? PAD : ...), headFont and bodyFont swap to Frank Ruhl Libre and Assistant, dirOf per line

rules.rule: Words readable on their background, 3:1 for large text
rules.built_by: AdMaker inkOnCol, lightGround and fg() pick ink from the ground's luminance; pillOn for the price

rules.rule: Picture leaving the site is drawn at 2160 wide from the best photo
rules.built_by: utils/sharpCanvas sharpCanvas(target, scale) and bestPhoto(src) used by AdMaker and AdStudio

rules.rule: Drawn and looked at on the real business, at phone size, beside the reference
rules.built_by: to build: ad-gen-runner writes a contact sheet (ad, its source ad, phone-size frame) automatically

rules.rule: Would it stop you? One sentence of what is surprising
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'surprise' field, required

rules.rule: Owner can change every word and the price stays right
rules.built_by: AdMaker words panel edits every field; adIssues keeps the price tied to the featured item

rules.rule: Cost read from the API before generating, spend reported
rules.built_by: to build: ad-gen-runner reads the credit price from the API first, stops above a cap, appends the spend to ad-brief

rules.rule: Never bland: beside the pro ads, five yes or no
rules.built_by: scripts/ad_vs_pros.py makes the sheet; to build: ad-gen-runner runs it after every picture and gives no 'shown' link on any no

rules.rule: Added copies of the product match the real photo
rules.built_by: scripts/product-match-sheet.py compares piece by piece; to build: the prompt builder writes the product traits into the prompt from ad-brief

rules.rule: A 5, or not shown: beside four 5/5 library ads of its kind
rules.built_by: scripts/ad-vs-library.py refuses weak kinds; to build: ad-brief 'kind' chosen at stage 1 so the refusal happens before a picture is paid for

rules.rule: One idea you get in a second
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'idea' (same field as A9e.3), required

rules.rule: Words and picture interlock (word behind the subject, or subject inside letters)
rules.built_by: AdMaker drawBehind puts the cut-out product in front of the word; to build: layout-sketch preset 'word behind' for generated pictures

rules.rule: One colour world from the product's own colour, one accent
rules.built_by: AdMaker vividColour, lookOf and LOOKS take colour from the photo; colAccent still falls back to stock yellow #FFD600, to build: take the accent from the product

rules.rule: A frozen moment, true to the product
rules.built_by: to build: ad-brief 'moment' field and a prompt-builder line tied to the real cause

rules.rule: Light that shapes: one strong side or back light
rules.built_by: to build: prompt builder fixed light clause (one side or back light, fall to dark); AdMaker paintGround and paintGrain give only a ground

rules.rule: Picture, headline and name carry it; link, code and price small
rules.built_by: AdMaker footBand and cornerFoot keep link, QR and price in the foot at fixed sizes; to build: one size table in ad-kit

rules.rule: Headline 2 to 5 spoken words, big, in two voices
rules.built_by: to build: headline generator limit of 5 words and a two-voice style (keyLine and stripLine in AdMaker already do bold key word plus line)

rules.rule: The product is the hero, half the width or more, on its set
rules.built_by: to build: ad-layout-sketch preset with the product box at 50 percent width or more; AdMaker drawShoot and drawGiant do it for cut-outs

rules.rule: Moving ad ends on the same picture as the still
rules.built_by: AdMaker moving export draws the same design as the still; its last frame is the still (comment at line 3735)

rules.rule: First frame is already an ad, never an empty ground
rules.built_by: AdMaker hookCard() with HOOK = 1 second, key word large on the ad's colour

rules.rule: One big word, move, hold 1.5s still, QR still over 3s
rules.built_by: AdMaker MOVE_ENDS 3.6s of 6.5s, part() delay table (qr appears at 1.55s), pieceMove

rules.rule: MP4 H.264 at full 1080 width, about 6 seconds, readable without sound
rules.built_by: AdMaker VIDEO_SECONDS = 6.5 and File 'ad-<format>.mp4' (video/mp4)
